# Furniture browser fixture photographs

Public Friendly Party Rental catalog photographs retrieved September 26, 2026. Kept locally so browser verification makes no external image or API requests. These are reference product photographs, not generated renderings.

- `6ft-plastic-folding-table.png`: https://www.friendlypartyrental.com/api/item-image/6ft-plastic-folding-table?v=1787311346517
- `cross-back-farmhouse-chair.png`: https://www.friendlypartyrental.com/api/item-image/cross-back-farmhouse-chair?v=1787094416619
- `sweetheart-table-60in-half-round.png`: https://www.friendlypartyrental.com/api/item-image/sweetheart-table-60in-half-round?v=1789322134472

The API fixture deliberately preserves these three products' original `other` category, null visual model and missing dimensions. Production catalog inference must resolve them. Photo appearance does not verify model measurements.

These offline UI fixtures are resized to fit a 640-pixel square; the catalog uses the original public photo URLs.
